newsitem.title: BELGIUM: ActivCard to issue convertible bond. [CORRECTED 11:25 GMT]
newsitem.headline: ActivCard to issue convertible bond. [CORRECTED 11:25 GMT]

text.p: ActivCard SA, listed on the Brussels-based EASDAQ small caps market, has decided to propose to its shareholders to issue up to $15 million (corrects to add words "up to") in convertible bonds, the exchange said on Monday.

The firm, a developer and maker of user, data and host authentication systems for the Internet and business Intranets, has picked Bryan Garnier of London and Cross Border in New York to handle the issue.
The firm, headquartered in France and with offices in California and Singapore, will use the money for developments in the United States and Asia.
